searchText: Back then I had the in-retrospect obviously foolish opinion that we would be able to quickly convince everyone to use smart contract wallets, and those could just log what they need to log I do think that decision just led to a lot of needless bugs in exchanges, and we should reverse it and switch to logging eth-sending calls by default
